mode: check only; no main checkout mutation
checks: UTF8 BOM/EOL and inverse merge user delta proof
rollback does not overwrite foreign edits
new protection snapshot retains original chain

findings.finding: Create safe exclusive receipt before validating main/worktree so rejected valid-root requests are auditable.
Write mutation intent to receipt before each target/index/ref operation.
Reject any lexical overlap between run root and a checkout before making a run directory.

residuals: Concurrent external writers cannot be prevented by the tool-specific lock; changed foreign bytes are preserved and the outcome becomes state_unknown.
Power loss or a storage failure preventing all receipt writes cannot be represented as confirmed rollback.
Only added/modified regular files and uniform-newline UTF8 tracked overlaps are supported; other cases stop before main writes.
